svg.aria-label: The agent asks three questions: measured changes, release kind, website submodule. The answers file then passes through init, render, verify and github: rules are written, CONTRIBUTING, the PR template and workflows appear, the checks pass, and the ruleset, squash merges and secret scanning are switched on.
svg.text: Three answers, then it runs itself
You decide three things. A script does the rest.
